purpose.summary: This CICS online program (HCMADB02) adds prescription details for a patient to a DB2 database. It receives patient and prescription data via a COMMAREA, validates the commarea, processes start and end dates, and performs DB2 INSERT/UPDATE operations for prescription records in a healthcare application.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (DB2) embedded SQL with SQLCA
EXEC CICS commands including ABEND, RETURN
EIB (Execute Interface Block) fields used for transaction/terminal/task identification
DFHCOMMAREA linkage with multiple REDEFINES for different request types (patient, medication, meditation, threshold, visit)
Inline-expanded copybooks with source path comments (HCERRSWS.cpy, SQLCA.cpy, HCCMAREA.cpy)
